title: Grant and revoke platform admin rights
caption: The account must be active, verified and have MFA on. The first admin of a system comes from the CLI (admin:grant).

steps.title: List
steps.expect: Your own Revoke button is disabled with 'You cannot revoke your own admin rights.'; the last admin's too.

steps.title: Grant
steps.body: **Grant admin rights** → 'E-mail address of the account' + reason → **Grant admin rights** (+ code).
steps.expect: '<name> is now a platform admin.'; refusals worded: no account, already admin, not active, e-mail not verified, MFA not enabled.

steps.title: Revoke
steps.body: **Revoke the admin rights of <name>** → **Revoke admin rights** (+ code, no reason).
steps.expect: '<name> is no longer a platform admin.'; their next console request goes to sign-in; their password step is refused like a wrong password.
